title: Quarterly slab decomposition and hire spline probe
content:
Purpose:
Quick exploratory sheet to decompose quarterly slab capacity into fine-grained hiring tranches ("spline") and tie price-elasticity triggers to explicit hiring / hiring-freeze actions. Intended as a lightweight probe for exec/FP&A review before we formalize into the central workbook.

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- We model 3 price shock scenarios (mild -5%, medium -12%, severe -25%) and the resulting net revenue migration across product slabs (hosted API token tiers + dedicated contracts).
- Translate revenue delta into headcount levers using a per-role cost ladder: SRE/Infra = $320k fully-burdened, Eng = $260k, Sales/CS = $160k, Ops = $140k.
- Build a 6-quarter spline of hiring waves: baseline hiring cadence (Q0..Q5) vs compressed (freeze) vs accelerated (shore up capacity). Each knot maps to a hiring action and a budget delta.

Key assumptions:
- ARR and token mix baseline from Q3 billing extracts (cohort-weighted run-rate = $76.5M annualized).
- Variable gross margin on hosted tokens = 48% pre-quantization savings; quantization adoption adds +6pp to margin at scale.
- Dedicated contract churn elasticity: price decrease -> small timing benefit (2–6% retention uplift) but high revenue per-account sensitivity.
- Time-to-hire median = 8 weeks for senior infra, 6 weeks for mid-engineer, 4 weeks for CS hires.

Headcount tranche (example table):
Knot | Quarter | Role bucket | Planned hires | Cumulative FTE | Fully-burdened cost (k)
K1 | Q0 | Infra | 2 | 2 | 640
K2 | Q1 | Eng | 6 | 8 | 1560
K3 | Q2 | CS | 4 | 12 | 640
K4 | Q3 | Ops | 3 | 15 | 420
Notes: cost column uses above ladder; we treat contractors at +30% cost premium per FTE equivalent.

Budget decomposition (textual cells):
- Fixed platform opex: rent, license, central infra ops = $9.2M annualized.
- Variable inference cost: baseline $18M with quantization path down to $12M in medium adoption scenario.
- Sales & CS variable: modeled as % of ARR (4.5% baseline).

Pricing sensitivity mapping (actionable triggers):
Scenario A - Mild (-5% avg price):
- Revenue change: -3.1% (mix effect offsets some loss).
- Action: defer 40% of non-critical hiring planned in next two quarters (engineer interns, junior hires); preserve infra hires that secure latency SLA.
- Expected savings (6 months): ~$2.6M.

Scenario B - Medium (-12% avg price):
- Revenue change: -8.0%
- Action: immediate hiring freeze on non-infra engineering, pause two sales hires, pause 50% of ops hiring, renegotiate burst GPU leases.
- Expected savings (6 months): ~$7.1M.

Scenario C - Severe (-25% avg price):
- Revenue change: -17.4%
- Action: targeted 10% reduction in headcount via attrition/voluntary separation (skew to contractors and open reqs), accelerate quantization migration to cut inference cost, push Dedicated contract price-floor renegotiation.
- Expected savings (6 months): ~$18.4M plus margin recovery via quantization.

Sensitivity table (simplified):
Input var | Low | Base | High | Impact on 6mo cash
Hosted price delta | -25% | 0% | +5% | +/- $X (see model)
Token mix (embedding share) | 12% | 18% | 25% | +/- $Y
Quantization adoption speed | slow | base | fast | $12M savings range
Hiring velocity (weeks) | 4-14 | 8 | 6 | changes hiring cost by +/- 25%

Monte Carlo note:
- We ran 10k draws over hosted-price and token-mix distributions (triangular priors). Median 6mo burn delta aligns with Scenario B in current priors. Full notebook + code in linked PR.

Operational playbook (triage ladder):
1) Signal: 7-day trailing ARR movement > 6% relative to forecast -> Finance issues status-red.
2) Short-term ops: Freeze non-critical contractor renewals, postpone market-facing events, pull back on cloud-burst reservations.
3) Mid-term: Implement tranche hiring freeze lines (knot-level decisions) and re-run spline to see capacity gaps.
4) Long-term: Renegotiate contract SLAs and re-price renewal cohorts.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Validate per-account retention elasticity for Dedicated contracts (need cust success cohort data).
- Pull exact hiring pipeline from Greenhouse (open reqs) and map to knots.
- Add a second dimension: regional price differences (NA/EU/APAC) to see localized headcount impact.
- Build a dashboard card in Console to surface live slab-price delta vs run-rate.

Quick checks to run before review:
- Cross-check infra FTE ladder with eng payroll file (payroll export id: PAY-2026-09).
- Confirm quantization cost curve assumptions with Applied ML (Rafael).
- Reconcile GAAP vs cash timing for severance modeling.

Appendix (scratch notes):
- If we hit Scenario B for two consecutive quarters, trigger a formal FP&A reforecast and involve CEO/CTO.
- Consider a small experimental price-floor on new Dedicated deals to preserve margin while offering term discounts.

(Notes to self: convert this into a central sheet with scenario toggles, slider for price delta, and automated knot-level hiring impact matrix. Flagged for FP&A review week of 2026-10-25.)
